title: What Edge AI Microcontrollers Is
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Edge AI microcontrollers are tiny chips that run neural networks on milliwatts: a Cortex-M or RISC-V core paired with a neural accelerator, executing vision, audio, and sensor models entirely on-device with no cloud round trip. This record is the entry point of the teaching ladder for Edge AI Microcontrollers: start here, then move through the research state, the specifications, the public developments, the open challenges, and finally each piece needed to build it.
key_points: Edge AI Microcontrollers in one line: Edge AI microcontrollers are tiny chips that run neural networks on milliwatts: a Cortex-M or RISC-V core paired with a neural accelerator, executing vision, audio, and sensor models entirely on-device with no cloud round trip.
Why it matters: They put intelligence into everything with a battery — private, instant, and working without connectivity..
Where it is used: wearables, smart sensors, predictive maintenance, voice interfaces, agriculture..

t: Current Research State of Edge AI Microcontrollers
